scopeLabel: Google official Japanese Pixel smartphone model release table and explicitly model-named safety/regulatory support documents, through 2026-10-31

universe.notes: Official manufacturer release table enumerates all 2016-2026 Pixel phone models through Pixel 11; five rows explicitly contain two sibling models separated by vertical bar, expanded without family guessing. The separate official safety/regulatory index explicitly links model names to manufacturer-controlled model-specific support documents. Publication is support_only unless an independently explicit model-specific user guide is verified. General Pixel Help homepage must never be published as an exact per-model manual or treated as manufacturer-defined shared without explicit model listing. Pixel Tablet/Watch and unlisted regions excluded.

review.publicationGate: blocked until every one of 38 release-list models has a verified specific manufacturer document link or held with secondary discovery
review.notes: Regulatory/safety/support documents are NOT operational user manuals. If the only accepted evidence is regulatory/safety material, model is support_only, not direct or shared.
